text: 休言女子非英物，夜夜龙泉壁上鸣
pinyin: xiū yán nǚ zǐ fēi yīng wù, yè yè lóng quán bì shàng míng
literal: don't · say · woman · not · heroic · person, night · night · Longquan sword · wall · on · ring
natural: don't say a woman is no hero: night after night the sword rings on the wall

meaning.en: Qiu Jin's proud declaration that women can be heroes too; her sword hangs on the wall and hums each night, eager for action.
meaning.zh: 秋瑾的诗句：不要说女子不是英雄人物，壁上的宝剑夜夜鸣响，渴望一试。

equivalents: a woman's courage is no less than a man's

examples.zh: 她在演讲中引用“休言女子非英物，夜夜龙泉壁上鸣”，赢得满堂掌声。
examples.en: In her speech she quoted 'Don't say women are no heroes: night after night the sword sings on the wall', to loud applause.

examples.zh: 休言女子非英物，夜夜龙泉壁上鸣，这句诗激励了一代女性。
examples.en: 'Don't say women are no heroes' inspired a generation of women.

origin.source: 秋瑾《鹧鸪天·祖国沉沦感不禁》

story.en: The couplet closes this lyric by the poet and revolutionary Qiu Jin, who wrote of national humiliation and her wish to serve the country.
story.zh: 秋瑾的词《鹧鸪天》（“祖国沉沦感不禁”）结尾两句，抒发忧国之情与报国之志。

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of women's courage and achievement. Qiu Jin (秋瑾, 1875–1907) was a poet and revolutionary executed by the Qing authorities. 龙泉 is a famous sword. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常用于谈论女性的胆识与成就。秋瑾（1875—1907）是诗人和革命者，被清政府处决。龙泉是名剑。书面语。

text: 拼将十万头颅血，须把乾坤力挽回
pinyin: pīn jiāng shí wàn tóu lú xuè, xū bǎ qián kūn lì wǎn huí
literal: stake · take · hundred thousand · heads · blood, must · (object) · heaven and earth · with force · pull back
natural: stake the blood of a hundred thousand heads to turn the world around

meaning.en: A patriotic vow: even at the cost of countless lives, the fate of the nation must be turned around.
meaning.zh: 爱国誓言：哪怕付出无数人的鲜血，也要力挽国家的危局。

equivalents: sacrifice all to save the nation
turn the tide at any cost

examples.zh: 他在纪念会上朗诵了“拼将十万头颅血，须把乾坤力挽回”。
examples.en: At the memorial he recited 'Stake the blood of a hundred thousand to turn the world around'.

examples.zh: 拼将十万头颅血，须把乾坤力挽回，体现了诗人的牺牲精神。
examples.en: The couplet shows the poet's spirit of sacrifice.

origin.source: 秋瑾《黄海舟中日人索句并见日俄战争地图》

story.en: Qiu Jin wrote the poem aboard ship in the Yellow Sea, when Japanese acquaintances asked her for a verse and showed her a map of the Russo-Japanese War.
story.zh: 秋瑾在黄海舟中，日本友人索句并出示日俄战争地图，她写下此诗，末两句即此联。

usage.en: Patriotic and grand in tone; quoted at commemorations and in essays about the late Qing revolutionaries. Literary register.
usage.zh: 语气豪壮，常见于纪念活动和谈论晚清革命者的文章。书面语。

text: 不惜千金买宝刀，貂裘换酒也堪豪
pinyin: bù xī qiān jīn mǎi bǎo dāo, diāo qiú huàn jiǔ yě kān háo
literal: not · grudge · thousand · gold · buy · precious · sword, sable · fur coat · swap · wine · also · worthy · bold
natural: spare no gold for a fine sword; trading a fur coat for wine is bold too

meaning.en: Heroic spirit: willing to spend a fortune on a sword and to pawn a fur coat for wine.
meaning.zh: 形容豪迈的气概：不惜重金买宝刀，当掉貂裘换酒喝也显得豪爽。

equivalents: spare no expense for a blade

examples.zh: 他在题字时写下“不惜千金买宝刀，貂裘换酒也堪豪”。
examples.en: When inscribing the scroll he wrote 'Spare no gold for a fine sword'.

examples.zh: 不惜千金买宝刀，貂裘换酒也堪豪，诗中满是侠气。
examples.en: The couplet is full of the chivalrous spirit.

story.en: The opening couplet of Qiu Jin's poem 'Facing the Wine'; the poem ends by saying her hot blood, once spilled, would turn to green waves.
story.zh: 秋瑾《对酒》开头两句；诗末称一腔热血洒出，也能化为碧涛。

usage.en: Quoted for its bold, chivalrous tone; Qiu Jin was known for dressing in men's clothes and practising swordsmanship. Literary register.
usage.zh: 因其豪放侠气而被引用；秋瑾以着男装、习剑术著称。书面语。

text: 身不得，男儿列，心却比，男儿烈
pinyin: shēn bù dé, nán ér liè, xīn què bǐ, nán ér liè
literal: body · cannot · get, men · ranks, heart · yet · compare, men · fierce
natural: my body cannot join the ranks of men, yet my heart is as fiery as theirs

meaning.en: A woman's lament and defiance: barred from a man's place in society, her heart burns as fiercely as any man's.
meaning.zh: 女子的慨叹与不甘：身为女子不能跻身男儿之列，心志却比男儿更烈。

equivalents: a heart no less brave than a man's
kept out of the ranks, yet just as fierce

examples.zh: 她读到“身不得，男儿列，心却比，男儿烈”，不禁热血沸腾。
examples.en: Reading 'my body cannot join the ranks of men, yet my heart is as fierce', she felt her blood stir.

examples.zh: 身不得，男儿列，心却比，男儿烈，这是秋瑾的自白。
examples.en: 'Not in the ranks of men, but fiercer in heart' is Qiu Jin's self-portrait.

story.en: Qiu Jin wrote this lyric while staying in Beijing; the lines express her frustration at being unable to take a man's place in public life.
story.zh: 秋瑾客居京华时所作《满江红》，这几句抒写不能与男子并列于世的愤懑。

usage.en: Quoted when speaking of women's ambition under social constraints. Literary register; the short lines are in the 满江红 metre.
usage.zh: 常用来谈论女性在社会束缚下的志向。书面语，短句出自《满江红》词牌。

text: 以美育代宗教
pinyin: yǐ měi yù dài zōng jiào
literal: use · aesthetic · education · replace · religion
natural: replace religion with aesthetic education

meaning.en: Cai Yuanpei's proposal that education in art and beauty, not religion, should nourish people's moral feelings.
meaning.zh: 蔡元培的主张：用美育来培养人的情操，代替宗教的作用。

examples.zh: 蔡元培提倡以美育代宗教，主张学校加强艺术教育。
examples.en: Cai Yuanpei urged replacing religion with aesthetic education and stronger arts teaching in schools.

examples.zh: 讨论艺术课的作用时，老师提到了“以美育代宗教”。
examples.en: In discussing the role of art classes, the teacher mentioned 'replace religion with aesthetic education'.

origin.source: 蔡元培《以美育代宗教说》（1917年）

story.en: Cai Yuanpei, then president of Peking University, gave the talk in 1917 at the Shenzhou Society in Beijing and later published it as an essay.
story.zh: 1917年，时任北京大学校长的蔡元培在北京神州学会作此演讲，后整理成文发表。

usage.en: A slogan of Chinese educational thought, often cited in debates on art education. Strictly it is a 1917 proposal, not a classical line.
usage.zh: 中国教育思想史上的口号，常见于艺术教育讨论。严格说是1917年提出的主张，而非古典名句。

text: 出了研究室就入监狱，出了监狱就入研究室
pinyin: chū le yán jiū shì jiù rù jiān yù, chū le jiān yù jiù rù yán jiū shì
literal: leave · (particle) · research room · then · enter · prison, leave · (particle) · prison · then · enter · research room
natural: out of the lab and into prison, out of prison and into the lab

meaning.en: Chen Duxiu's call to young people to devote themselves to both science and the struggle for justice, accepting prison as part of the path.
meaning.zh: 陈独秀的名言：号召青年既投身科学研究，也不惧为理想入狱，两者交替而不退缩。

equivalents: from lab to cell and back again

examples.zh: 演讲中他引用了“出了研究室就入监狱，出了监狱就入研究室”。
examples.en: In his talk he quoted 'out of the lab and into prison, out of prison and into the lab'.

examples.zh: 出了研究室就入监狱，出了监狱就入研究室，他的一生正是如此。
examples.en: Out of the lab and into prison, out of prison and into the lab: his life was exactly that.

origin.source: 陈独秀《研究室与监狱》（1919年）

story.en: Chen Duxiu wrote the essay in 1919 for the journal 'Weekly Review' (《每周评论》), saying that the two sources of civilisation are the research room and the prison.
story.zh: 1919年陈独秀在《每周评论》发表此文，称世界文明的发源地有二：研究室与监狱。

usage.en: Often quoted about intellectuals who combine research with political commitment. Literary register. It was published in 1919 under a pen name; the attribution to Chen Duxiu is standard.
usage.zh: 常用来形容把学术研究与政治担当结合起来的知识分子。书面语。1919年以笔名发表，通行说法认定为陈独秀所作。

text: 鸟笼经济
pinyin: niǎo lóng jīng jì
literal: bird · cage · economy
natural: birdcage economy

meaning.en: The idea, associated with Chen Yun, that a market economy should be given freedom like a bird, but only within the cage of state planning.
meaning.zh: 与陈云相关的比喻：搞活经济要像鸟一样自由，但只能在计划这个“笼子”里飞。

examples.zh: 改革初期，人们常用“鸟笼经济”来比喻计划与市场的关系。
examples.en: In the early reform years the 'birdcage economy' was a common metaphor for the relation of plan and market.

examples.zh: 教授在课上讲解了鸟笼经济的含义和争论。
examples.en: The professor explained the meaning of the 'birdcage economy' and the debate around it.

usage.en: A term from 1980s economic debate, attributed to the veteran leader Chen Yun (陈云): the bird is the economy, the cage the plan. Today it is used as a historical reference. The exact date and wording of his remarks are reported differently, so no origin is given.
usage.zh: 20世纪80年代经济论争中的提法，通常归于老一辈领导人陈云：鸟指经济，笼指计划。今天多作历史回顾时引用。其讲话的确切时间和措辞说法不一，故不标出处。

text: 怕什么真理无穷，进一寸有一寸的欢喜
pinyin: pà shén me zhēn lǐ wú qióng, jìn yī cùn yǒu yī cùn de huān xǐ
literal: fear · what · truth · endless, advance · one · inch · have · one · inch · 's · joy
natural: why fear that truth is endless? every inch gained is an inch of joy

meaning.en: Hu Shi's encouragement to seekers of knowledge: truth has no end, but each small step forward brings its own joy.
meaning.zh: 胡适的名言，勉励求知者：真理永无止境，但每前进一点就有一分欣喜。

equivalents: every step forward is its own reward
the journey of learning is endless but joyful

examples.zh: 老师在毕业典礼上说：“怕什么真理无穷，进一寸有一寸的欢喜。”
examples.en: At graduation the teacher said, 'Why fear that truth is endless? Every inch forward brings joy.'

examples.zh: 科研路上难免受挫，但怕什么真理无穷，进一寸有一寸的欢喜。
examples.en: Setbacks are inevitable in research, but every inch of progress is a joy.

usage.en: Commonly attributed to Hu Shi (胡适) and quoted to encourage students and researchers. The exact work in which it first appeared is reported differently, so no origin is given.
usage.zh: 通常认为出自胡适，常用来勉励学生和研究者。最初见于哪篇文章说法不一，故不标出处。

text: 差不多先生
pinyin: chā bù duō xiān shēng
literal: almost · not · much · Mr.
natural: Mr. Close-Enough

meaning.en: A satirical figure from Hu Shi's story: a man who says 'close enough' about everything, and so is careless and never exact.
meaning.zh: 胡适笔下的讽刺形象：凡事都说“差不多”，马马虎虎、不求精确的人。

examples.zh: 他做事总是敷衍，同事们叫他差不多先生。
examples.en: He is always slapdash, and his colleagues call him Mr Close-Enough.

examples.zh: 别做差不多先生，细节决定成败。
examples.en: Don't be Mr Close-Enough; details decide success or failure.

story.en: Hu Shi wrote this satirical biography of the man who says 'close enough' to everything, criticising a national habit of carelessness.
story.zh: 胡适作此讽刺性传记，写一位凡事“差不多”的先生，批评国人马虎的习惯。

usage.en: Used for people who are careless and say 'it's about the same'. Humorous or critical; casual register. In the story Mr Chā Bù Duō (his surname 差 chā) dies after a careless doctor mistakes a vet for a physician, saying 'close enough'.
usage.zh: 用来指马虎、爱说“差不多”的人，带调侃或批评，口语。故事中差不多先生因庸医（兽医）误诊而死，临终仍说“差不多”。

text: 要怎么收获，先那么栽
pinyin: yào zěn me shōu huò, xiān nà me zāi
literal: want · how · harvest, first · that way · plant
natural: to reap as you wish, first plant that way

meaning.en: Hu Shi's inscription: whatever harvest you want, you must plant accordingly; results follow effort.
meaning.zh: 胡适的题词：想要什么样的收获，就要先怎样栽种；有付出才有回报。

equivalents: as you sow, so shall you reap

examples.zh: 老师在贺卡上写下“要怎么收获，先那么栽”。
examples.en: The teacher wrote 'to reap as you wish, first plant that way' on the card.

examples.zh: 想有好成绩，就记住要怎么收获，先那么栽。
examples.en: If you want good grades, remember: to reap as you wish, plant accordingly.

usage.en: Commonly attributed to Hu Shi as an inscription (题词). The occasion and the original wording are not firmly established, so no origin is given. Often confused with the proverb 一分耕耘，一分收获.
usage.zh: 通常认为是胡适的题词。具体场合和原文措辞无定论，故不标出处。常与俗语“一分耕耘，一分收获”相混。

text: 容忍比自由更重要
pinyin: róng rěn bǐ zì yóu gèng zhòng yào
literal: tolerance · compared with · freedom · more · important
natural: tolerance is more important than freedom

meaning.en: Hu Shi's argument that a free society depends on tolerance of those who disagree with us.
meaning.zh: 胡适的观点：自由社会的根基是容忍与自己意见不同的人。

examples.zh: 讨论言论自由时，他引用了“容忍比自由更重要”。
examples.en: In the discussion on free speech he quoted 'tolerance is more important than freedom'.

examples.zh: 容忍比自由更重要，没有容忍，自由也难以长久。
examples.en: Tolerance is more important than freedom; without it freedom cannot last.

story.en: Hu Shi delivered and published the essay in 1959, near the end of his life, arguing that tolerance is the root of freedom.
story.zh: 1959年胡适晚年发表《容忍与自由》，论证容忍是自由的根基。

usage.en: Quoted in discussions of free speech and civility. Hu Shi's 1959 essay argues that without tolerance of dissent there is no lasting freedom. Formal register.
usage.zh: 常见于谈论言论自由与包容的文章。胡适1959年的文章论证：不能容忍异见，自由就难以长久。书面语。

text: 有几分证据，说几分话
pinyin: yǒu jǐ fēn zhèng jù, shuō jǐ fēn huà
literal: have · how many · parts · evidence, say · how many · parts · words
natural: say only as much as the evidence supports

meaning.en: Hu Shi's rule of scholarship: claim only what your evidence can bear.
meaning.zh: 胡适的治学原则：有多少证据，就说多少话，不夸大。

equivalents: say no more than the evidence shows

examples.zh: 导师提醒我写论文要有几分证据，说几分话。
examples.en: My supervisor reminded me to say only as much as the evidence supports in a paper.

examples.zh: 记者应当有几分证据，说几分话。
examples.en: A reporter should say only as much as the evidence supports.

usage.en: Commonly attributed to Hu Shi and often quoted together with 大胆假设，小心求证. The original source is not firmly established, so no origin is given.
usage.zh: 通常认为出自胡适，常与“大胆假设，小心求证”并提。最初出处无定论，故不标出处。

text: 为学要如金字塔，要能广大要能高
pinyin: wéi xué yào rú jīn zì tǎ, yào néng guǎng dà yào néng gāo
literal: pursue · learning · should · be like · pyramid, must · be able · broad · must · be able · high
natural: study like a pyramid: broad and high

meaning.en: Hu Shi's advice that scholarship should be like a pyramid, with a broad base of general knowledge and a high peak of specialisation.
meaning.zh: 胡适的治学建议：学问要像金字塔，既要基础广博，又要专精高深。

examples.zh: 毕业赠言里，他写下了“为学要如金字塔，要能广大要能高”。
examples.en: In the graduation inscription he wrote 'study like a pyramid: broad and high'.

examples.zh: 为学要如金字塔，要能广大要能高，这是对学生的期望。
examples.en: 'Study like a pyramid, broad and high' is the hope for students.

usage.en: Commonly attributed to Hu Shi as advice to students. The occasion and exact source are reported differently, so no origin is given.
usage.zh: 通常认为是胡适对学生的赠言。具体场合和出处说法不一，故不标出处。

text: 以青春之我，创建青春之家庭，青春之国家，青春之民族
pinyin: yǐ qīng chūn zhī wǒ, chuàng jiàn qīng chūn zhī jiā tíng, qīng chūn zhī guó jiā, qīng chūn zhī mín zú
literal: with · youthful · 's · self, create · youthful · 's · family, youthful · 's · nation, youthful · 's · people
natural: with a youthful self, build a youthful family, nation and people

meaning.en: Li Dazhao's call to young people to renew themselves and, through that, their family, nation and people.
meaning.zh: 李大钊的号召：青年以自身的青春活力，去创建充满朝气的家庭、国家和民族。

equivalents: renew yourself to renew the nation
youth as the engine of national revival

examples.zh: 毕业典礼上，校长引用了“以青春之我，创建青春之家庭，青春之国家，青春之民族”。
examples.en: At graduation the principal quoted 'with a youthful self, build a youthful family, nation and people'.

examples.zh: 以青春之我，创建青春之家庭，青春之国家，青春之民族，是李大钊对青年的期望。
examples.en: 'Build a youthful family, nation and people with a youthful self' was Li Dazhao's hope for the young.

origin.source: 李大钊《青春》，《新青年》第2卷第1号（1916年）

story.en: Li Dazhao published the essay 'Youth' in the journal 'New Youth' (《新青年》) in September 1916, urging young people to cast off a decaying past.
story.zh: 1916年9月，李大钊在《新青年》发表《青春》，号召青年摆脱衰朽的过去。

usage.en: Quoted in speeches to young people; the full sentence continues with 青春之人类，青春之地球，青春之宇宙. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常见于对青年的演讲；原句后面还有“青春之人类，青春之地球，青春之宇宙”。书面语。

text: 温情与敬意
pinyin: wēn qíng yǔ jìng yì
literal: warmth · feeling · and · respect
natural: warmth and reverence

meaning.en: Qian Mu's phrase for the attitude one should hold towards one's own country's past: a measure of warm feeling and respect.
meaning.zh: 钱穆的用语：对本国已往历史应抱的态度，即一种温情与敬意。

equivalents: warmth and respect for the past

examples.zh: 钱穆主张对本国历史要有温情与敬意。
examples.en: Qian Mu held that one should treat one's national history with warmth and respect.

examples.zh: 评价传统文化时，我们要怀着温情与敬意。
examples.en: We should assess traditional culture with warmth and respect.

story.en: In the introduction Qian Mu wrote that readers of national history should have 'a measure of warmth and respect' towards their country's past.
story.zh: 钱穆在《国史大纲》引论中提出，读本国历史者应对本国已往历史抱有“温情与敬意”。

usage.en: Quoted in debates on how to approach tradition and history, sometimes criticised as too indulgent. Formal register.
usage.zh: 常见于讨论如何对待传统与历史的文章，也有人批评其过于宽容。书面语。

text: 我在哪里，哪里就是中国
pinyin: wǒ zài nǎ lǐ, nǎ lǐ jiù shì zhōng guó
literal: I · be at · where, where · then · is · China
natural: wherever I am, there is China

meaning.en: A saying often attributed to the historian Yu Yingshi: a scholar in exile carries the culture of China with him.
meaning.zh: 常被归于史学家余英时的话：流亡学者把中国文化带在身边，人在何处，中国就在何处。

equivalents: wherever I go, my homeland goes with me

examples.zh: 他在海外多年，常说“我在哪里，哪里就是中国”。
examples.en: Abroad for many years, he often said 'wherever I am, there is China'.

examples.zh: 文章用“我在哪里，哪里就是中国”来形容学人的文化认同。
examples.en: The article uses 'wherever I am, there is China' for a scholar's cultural identity.

usage.en: Widely attributed to Yu Yingshi (余英时, 1930–2021, based in the United States), but the original source is not firmly established, so no origin is given. It echoes Thomas Mann's 1938 'Where I am, there is Germany'. Politically sensitive, so quote with care.
usage.zh: 通常归于余英时（1930—2021，长期在美国）之名，但原始出处无定论，故不标出处。与托马斯·曼1938年所说“我在哪里，哪里就是德国”相呼应。涉及政治敏感，引用须谨慎。

text: 人生三境界
pinyin: rén shēng sān jìng jiè
literal: life · three · stages
natural: the three stages of life

meaning.en: Wang Guowei's famous reading of three lines of Song lyrics as the three stages of great achievement: loneliness, devotion, and sudden insight.
meaning.zh: 王国维用三句宋词比喻成就大事业、大学问的三种境界：孤独求索、执着付出、豁然顿悟。

examples.zh: 老师用人生三境界来勉励同学们做学问。
examples.en: The teacher used the three stages of life to encourage students in their studies.

examples.zh: 人生三境界，第一层是“望尽天涯路”。
examples.en: The first of the three stages of life is 'gazing to the end of the road'.

story.en: In his critical work on lyric poetry, Wang Guowei borrowed lines by Yan Shu, Liu Yong and Xin Qiji to describe the three stages anyone must pass through to achieve great things.
story.zh: 王国维在《人间词话》中借晏殊、柳永、辛弃疾的词句，比喻成就大事业、大学问必经的三种境界。

usage.en: Wang Guowei (王国维) in 《人间词话》 quoted three lines as the three stages: 昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路 (Yan Shu), 衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴 (Liu Yong) and 众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处 (Xin Qiji). Each has its own entry. Very common in essays and graduation speeches.
usage.zh: 王国维在《人间词话》中引三句词作三境界：“昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路”（晏殊）、“衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴”（柳永）和“众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处”（辛弃疾），三句词均已单独收录。常见于作文和毕业演讲。

synonyms: 昨夜西风凋碧树，独上高楼，望尽天涯路
衣带渐宽终不悔，为伊消得人憔悴
众里寻他千百度，蓦然回首，那人却在，灯火阑珊处

text: 一切景语皆情语
pinyin: yī qiè jǐng yǔ jiē qíng yǔ
literal: all · scene · words · all · feeling · words
natural: all descriptions of scenery are expressions of feeling

meaning.en: Wang Guowei's remark that every description of a landscape in poetry is also an expression of the poet's feeling.
meaning.zh: 王国维的论断：诗词中一切写景的话，其实都是抒情的话。

equivalents: every landscape is a state of mind

examples.zh: 语文老师说，一切景语皆情语，要读出景物背后的心情。
examples.en: The Chinese teacher said all scenery words are feeling words, so read the mood behind the scenery.

examples.zh: 分析这首词时，不能忘了一切景语皆情语。
examples.en: In analysing this lyric, we must not forget that all scenery writing is feeling.

story.en: In the deleted manuscripts of 'Remarks on Lyrics' Wang Guowei contrasted 'scene words' and 'feeling words' and concluded that all scene words are feeling words.
story.zh: 王国维在《人间词话删稿》中谈到景语与情语之别，指出一切景语皆情语。

usage.en: Used in literary analysis and exam essays. Literary register. It appears in the 删稿 (deleted manuscripts) of 《人间词话》.
usage.zh: 常用于文学分析和作文。书面语。见于《人间词话》删稿。

text: 有我之境，无我之境
pinyin: yǒu wǒ zhī jìng, wú wǒ zhī jìng
literal: have · self · 's · realm, no · self · 's · realm
natural: the realm with self, the realm without self

meaning.en: Wang Guowei's two poetic realms: one where the poet's own feeling colours the scene, and one where the poet seems to vanish into nature.
meaning.zh: 王国维提出的两种诗境：一种是诗人情感浸染景物，另一种是诗人仿佛融入自然、物我两忘。

equivalents: seeing nature through feeling versus becoming one with it

examples.zh: 老师讲解了有我之境，无我之境的区别。
examples.en: The teacher explained the difference between the realm with self and the realm without self.

examples.zh: “采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”常被看作无我之境，对应有我之境，无我之境的说法。
examples.en: 'Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence' is often seen as the realm without self, in line with the distinction between realms with and without self.

story.en: In 'Remarks on Lyrics' (《人间词话》) Wang Guowei distinguished two kinds of poetic realm, and illustrated them with lines from Tao Yuanming and Ouyang Xiu.
story.zh: 王国维在《人间词话》中区分两种诗境，并以陶渊明、欧阳修等人的诗词为例。

usage.en: A term of poetics, common in literary study. In the original, Wang writes that there is the 'realm with self' (有我之境) and the 'realm without self' (无我之境). Formal register.
usage.zh: 诗学术语，常见于文学研究。原文说“有有我之境，有无我之境”。书面语。

text: 可爱者不可信，可信者不可爱
pinyin: kě ài zhě bù kě xìn, kě xìn zhě bù kě ài
literal: lovable · one · not · trustworthy, trustworthy · one · not · lovable
natural: what is lovable cannot be trusted, what is trustworthy cannot be loved

meaning.en: Wang Guowei's lament on the clash between feeling and reason: the doctrines that attract the heart fail the intellect, and the ones the mind trusts leave the heart cold.
meaning.zh: 王国维感叹情感与理性的冲突：令人喜爱的学说不可信，可信的学说又不令人喜爱。

equivalents: the heart and the head disagree
what charms is not true, what is true does not charm

examples.zh: 他引用“可爱者不可信，可信者不可爱”，感叹理想与现实难以两全。
examples.en: He quoted 'what is lovable cannot be trusted, what is trustworthy cannot be loved' to lament that ideal and reality rarely agree.

examples.zh: 读哲学时，常有可爱者不可信，可信者不可爱的矛盾。
examples.en: In studying philosophy one often meets the paradox of the lovable being untrustworthy and the trustworthy unlovable.

origin.source: 王国维《静安文集续编·自序二》（1907年）

story.en: Wang Guowei wrote in his second self-preface that in philosophy he found the lovable untrustworthy and the trustworthy unlovable.
story.zh: 王国维在《自序二》中谈到，他读哲学时发现可爱的不可信，可信的不可爱。

usage.en: Often quoted about the conflict of heart and head, and sometimes loosely about people. Literary register.
usage.zh: 常用来说明感情与理性的矛盾，有时也泛指人。书面语。
